 Versus  1. The State of Bihar  2. Anjali Kumari Daughter of Vijendra Chaudhary Resident of Village-  Kanhauli, P.S.-Bihta, District-Patna  ... ... Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Birendra Kumar, Adv.
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Upendra Kumar, APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE HARISH KUMAR  ORAL ORDER 2 13-06-2023 Heard Mr. Birendra Kumar, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. Upendra Kumar, learned APP for the State.

The petitioner, who happens to be the husband of the O.P.No.2, apprehending his arrest in connection with Arwal P.S. Case No. 246 of 2022 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 498A of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

It is alleged that the marriage of the O.P. No.2 was solemnized in the year 2020, and soon after the marriage, she was subjected to harassment on account of non-fulfillment of demand of dowry at the hands of the petitioner and his family members.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.19509 of 2023(2) dt.13-06-2023 Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the O.P. No.2 voluntarily deserted the petitioner though he is still ready to keep her with full honour and dignity.
Considering the submissions made on behalf of the petitioner, let notice be issued to the O.P. No. 2,
under both processes i.e. ordinary process as well as registered cover with A/D, for which requisites Rupesh Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 13 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/193561723/
1 etc.

List the case after receipt of the service of notice or on 25.07.2023, whichever is earlier.
In the meantime, no coercive steps shall be taken against the petitioner in connection with the aforenoted P.S. case.

(Harish Kumar, J) rohit/-
